project: Dream It Design It: garden v1 (the back garden steps down to the front lawn's level)
units: mm; design coordinates (x east, y north, z up, z 0 = ground-floor level)

levels.note: lower garden = the street front / front lawn level

parameter_limit: terrace_depth <= 6500 (measured 2026-10-25 with SolidCraft's clash check: 6500 no overlaps; 6600 the terrace slab and plinth run into the beds and the top step; the terrace edge must stay at or south of the beds, y 16500)

landscape_cuts.why: the garden lawn ends at the drop; the beds, steps and lower lawn take its place

beds.note: raised flower beds across the garden at the drop, edged in the house's split-face stone like the front beds: flush with the upper lawn, 450 above the lower lawn

steps.note: the same steps as the entry (STP-1): 3 m wide, 3 risers of 150, goings 400, a warm light in every riser; they go DOWN to the north

lower_lawn.note: at the foot of the steps, between the beds

plants.note: on the beds' soil; shrubs and ornamental grasses alternate, like the front beds
